mainText: <speak><voice name="Salli">Hey Verona, let's get into the dish! At 10 PM, we have beautiful clear skies over Badger Prairie County Park and a gorgeous full moon, though there are no visible ISS passes tonight. We are looking at an overnight low of 69 degrees with no rain on the horizon.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Justin">Get those creative juices flowing, Verona! Our local students are competing to design the official I Voted sticker for the upcoming election, so make sure to check out the entries.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Matthew">We have plenty of fun ahead! You can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness today, or gear up for trivia excitement tomorrow at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's.</voice></speak>
<speak><voice name="Kimberly">In our weekly look back, it was a busy night on July 23 when officers were dispatched to Lucerne Drive regarding a domestic incident.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Salli">You are going to love today's flavor, Snickers Swirl! It is a chocolatey delight, and while the shop is closed right now, you should definitely head over when they open at 10 AM tomorrow.</voice></speak>
